response.body: The proving zero energy before intrusive work shall be provided and maintained wherever this procedure applies, and its condition shall be treated as a critical control. This clause applies to activities archived under ELECTRICAL-SAFETY at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility.
